caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with a reddish-brown body and ornate detailing. The top of the clock features a central finial with a decorative curved design extending to both sides, flanked by two sculpted pineapple-shaped ornaments. The clock has two black, column-like structures on either side that extend vertically and have gold accents at their bases and tops. The clock face is square with a cream background, bordered by gold and green vine-like patterns in the corners. The clock face displays Roman numerals for the hours and has three black hands: an hour hand, a minute hand, and a longer, thinner second hand. Below the clock face, there is a horizontal rectangular section bordered with gold detailing and a green vine pattern, with a blank, lightly shaded interior. The clock stands on four clawed feet, finished in a dark brown color. The background of the drawing is a light beige, and the composition centers the clock with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Eli Terry Clock
